name: INARI
recent: Inari Amertron 公布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，营收与净利双双走高，并宣布每股 1.5 仙的首次中期股息。同期，公司因雇员认购 ESOS 期权而多次发行新股，雇员公积金局（EPF）与公务员退休基金局（KWAP）亦持续申报股权变动。
notable: 公布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，营收与净利均较去年同期上升。
宣布首次中期股息，每股 1.00 仙免税股息加 0.50 仙单层股息，合计 1.5 仙。
因雇员行使 ESOS 期权，分两批发行共约 305 万股新股并于 11 月 13 日上市。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次申报股权变动。
ESOS 期权持续行使导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM288.94 million，环比增长 8.7%，同比减少 5.8%；净利为 RM6.15 million，环比下降 78.0%，同比下降 87.5%，净利率为 2.1%，低于上一季度的 10.5%。

recent_en: Inari Amertron reported higher revenue and net profit for 1Q FY2027 and declared a first interim dividend of 1.5 sen per share. Meanwhile, the company issued new shares multiple times from ESOS option exercises, while EPF and KWAP continued to file changes in their substantial shareholder stakes.
notable_en: Announced 1Q FY2027 results with both revenue and net profit rising year-on-year.
Declared a first interim dividend of 1.00 sen exempt plus 0.50 sen single-tier per share, totalling 1.5 sen.
Issued about 3.05 million new shares in two tranches from ESOS option exercises, listed on 13 Nov.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder stakes from late October to mid-November.
Continued ESOS option exercises have gradually enlarged the share base.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM288.94 million, up 8.7% qoq but down 5.8% yoy; net income was RM6.15 million, down 78.0% qoq and 87.5% yoy, with net margin at 2.1% versus 10.5% in the prior quarter.
